title: pvSpyPlotReader
body:
## pvSpyPlotReader

Reads a CTH Spy Plot case: an ASCII .spcth case file listing the binary files that hold the data. Output port 0 is the volume data (a hierarchical composite of blocks with cell-centred arrays), port 1 the tracers and port 2 the markers. By ParaView default it derives material densities from selected material mass and volume fraction and merges X/Y/Z component arrays into vectors. Use pvRestartedSimSpyPlotReader for a restarted run split over several file sets and pvspcthhistoryreader for history files.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Fields are cell-centred block data; convert with cellToPoint before operations that need point data, such as streamline tracing.
- Derived densities need both Material Mass and Material Volume Fraction arrays selected.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `SpyPlotReader`. Identity: `sources/spcthreader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrays` | This property lists which cell-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ComputeDerivedVariables` | If this property is set to 1, the reader will convert derived variables like material density for the materials that the user has selected. For Density the user needs to have selected Material Mass and Material Volume Fraction. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DistributeFiles` | In parallel mode, if this property is set to 1, the reader will distribute files or blocks. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DownConvertVolumeFraction` | If this property is set to 0, the type of the volume fraction is float; is set to 1, the type is unsigned char. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the Spy Plot reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `GenerateActiveBlockArray` | If this property is set to 1, a cell array will be generated that stores the active status of a block. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateBlockIdArray` | If this property is set to 1, a cell array will be generated that stores a unique blockId for each block. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateLevelArray` | If this property is set to 1, a cell array will be generated that stores the level of each block. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateMarkers` | If this property is set to 1, a second output will be created using the markers data stored in the file. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateTracers` | If this property is set to 1, a cell array will be generated that stores the coordinates of any tracers. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MergeXYZComponents` | If this property is set to 1, cell arrays named (for example) X velocity, Y velocity and Z velocity will be combined into a single vector array named velocity. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": 3,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvSpyPlotReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
